entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: All right, that's good for today. Oh, but...[n]there's somethin' I wanna talk to you[n]about.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...It's about that secret Tsuda mentioned.[n]There's more to it than my havin' been[n]in the yakuza.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I just wanna make sure you don't go[n]sayin' somethin' stupid if you run into[n]Kaoru 'round here...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Back when I was workin' with the Hashiba[n]Clan, some crazy lady came 'round our[n]office. Must've been over ten years ago.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: She had this baby with her, and the whole[n]time she was there she kept goin' on about[n]how she wanted to sell it.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Figured she was just some cracked-up[n]junkie lookin' for drug money.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: But then when I told her no, she sat the[n]baby down and ran off.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...That baby was Kaoru.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Thinkin' back on it, I'm still not really[n]sure why I took him in...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Not only did I have to leave the clan, but[n]now I'm stuck runnin' this shop I don't[n]even like.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: *chuckle* Every day's an uphill battle.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I still haven't managed to tell Kaoru[n]I was in the yakuza though...
Why not?
You shouldn't lie to your son.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...Lemme ask you somethin'. How would[n]you feel if you found out your parents[n]were wrapped up in some dirty shit?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: That's how my mom was. She'd spend[n]every night out drinkin', runnin' around[n]town with all sortsa guys.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I couldn't stand to see her destroy herself[n]like that. Often I wished I could've had[n]someone else as my mom.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: So... I didn't wanna make Kaoru go[n]through the same thing. I wanted to[n]make sure he had a good childhood.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: That's why I left the clan. I did everythin'[n]according to the code, but now Tsuda's[n]draggin' me back...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Once he remembered I run this fake gun[n]shop, he came by askin' me to make[n]custom models for him.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Though he wasn't really askin'...[n]The bastard forced me into it by[n]threatenin' to tell Kaoru everythin'.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Truth is, Tsuda's got all sortsa dirt.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Not just on what happened when Kaoru[n]was a baby, but on me and the rest of[n]my family too.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Who knows what'd happen if Kaoru[n]learned the truth...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Tsuda isn't gonna stop there though.[n]I'm sure he'd go on and tell everyone[n]else he could.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: When it's all said and done, he's gonna[n]try and take everythin' I have.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: If word gets out about my past, people're[n]gonna treat Kaoru like he's no different[n]than me.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: After all, everyone knows shitty parents[n]end up makin' shitty kids...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: And once he's got that stigma, he'll be[n]stuck with it. When shit goes wrong,[n]he'll always be the one who gets blamed.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: That's how it was with me.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...That's why I turned to the yakuza.[n]Nobody else would accept me.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: That's also why I can't turn Tsuda down.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: He's just got too much power...
You're so kind, Iwai.
You're pathetic.[clr 27]
You should call the cops.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Pfft, don't gimme that exaggerated[n]bullcrap. I ain't kind at all...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: *chuckle* You got that right.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I bet Kaoru's sick of havin' a weak-ass dad[n]like me.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: That's not how shit works in our world.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...Though I guess a straight-laced kid[n]wouldn't understand that, huh?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Anyways, I was tryin' to stall Tsuda with[n]bullshit prototypes while I figured out[n]a way to stop him...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: But that bastard's real good at keepin'[n]his cards close to his chest.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Plus, he caught wind of what I was tryin'[n]to do and started keepin' tabs on me 24/7.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Thankfully, that's just about when you[n]showed up, kid.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: *sigh* Sorry for bringin' all that shit up[n]out of the blue.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...You prolly don't want anythin' to do[n]with me after that, huh?
That's right.
Don't make assumptions.
I'll stick around for the guns.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Can't say I blame you. You'd hafta be crazy[n]to wanna stick around here.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Hmph... It's cool if you wanna act tough[n]n' all, but don't forget to watch out for[n]yourself, kid.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Man... You're seriously into this[n]enthusiast shit.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Oh, right. Just remembered I never gave[n]you a reward for that info.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: You're right...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: How 'bout I give you a discount on[n]the special menu? That should keep you[n]quiet for a while.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Pretty good deal, huh?
It feels like my bond with Iwai[n]is growing even deeper...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...Damn, it's late. Should be gettin' home.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Kaoru's been eatin' a ton lately after[n]cram school. He's prolly gonna have[n]another growth spurt soon.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Anyways, I'm closin' up for today.[n]You should head home too.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Take it easy, kid.
